com.sun.xml.internal.bind.v2.runtime.reflect

类 Lister<BeanT,PropT,ItemT,PackT>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.xml.internal.bind.v2.runtime.reflect.Lister<BeanT,PropT,ItemT,PackT>
  • 直接已知子类:
    Lister.CollectionLister

    public abstract class Lister<BeanT,PropT,ItemT,PackT>
extends Object
    Used to list individual values of a multi-value property, and to pack individual values into a multi-value property.
    作者:
    Kohsuke Kawaguchi (kk@kohsuke.org)
